title: Itzhak Bentov's theories shaped CIA Gateway Process and Stargate

tellings.quote: His theories helped shape the foundation of the CIA's gateway process, [music] a protocol developed by consciousness researcher Robert Monroe in Virginia

plain: The ideas of a thinker named Itzhak Bentov, set out in his book Stalking the Wild Pendulum, are said to have helped lay the groundwork for the CIA's Gateway Process, a method for exploring altered states of mind developed by the consciousness researcher Robert Monroe in Virginia, and for the government's psychic spying work. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and also mentions the researcher Andrija Puharich in the same breath. If so, it would mean a fringe theory of consciousness shaped real US intelligence programmes in the 1970s.
